name: Caitlin Shannon
title: Communication strategist, writer and performance coach
bio_short: Communication strategist, playwright and keynote speaker with more than 15 years' experience. Clients include the European Central Bank, Novartis, Prudential and Linklaters. BAFTA member. Award-winning screenwriter for Amazon and History Channel.
bio: Caitlin is a communication strategist, playwright and keynote speaker with more than 15 years' experience working with clients across Europe, the United States, the Middle East and Australasia. She specialises in leadership communication, public speaking, negotiation skills and personal impact. As a training consultant at Impact Factory, her clients include the European Central Bank, Prudential, Novartis, Chanel, Linklaters, Minebea Intec and Independent Age.  Caitlin brings a distinctive creative background to her corporate training. She is a Brit-American actress, writer and director who has developed screenplays for Lightworkers Media and The History Channel, where she was a staff writer on The Bible. She wrote and directed the award-winning Amazon web series Wimpole Street, which won Best Comedy Web Series and Best Director at the Seattle Web Festival. She is a member of BAFTA and SAG-AFTRA, and her plays have been staged off-Broadway and at the Soho Theatre and Orange Tree Theatre in London.  At ISOC, Caitlin delivers public speaking, leadership communication, negotiation skills and interpersonal impact programmes. She is particularly effective at helping participants overcome presentation anxiety and develop a commanding, natural delivery style. Her performance background gives her an instinctive understanding of pacing, narrative structure and audience engagement. Caitlin is based in the UK and trains in English.
